name: recap
description: Recap the current session state by loading bounded working context and the latest federated context packet. Read-only; never persists anything.
authorityNotes: Uses only the load operation of membrane_working_context and the read-only membrane_context. No write-proposed authority is requested; the prompt cannot grant scope the underlying operations do not already provide.

arguments.name: sessionId
arguments.description: Session identifier whose active working contexts should be loaded via membrane_working_context.

arguments.name: taskId
arguments.description: Task identifier whose active working contexts should be loaded via membrane_working_context.

arguments.name: task
arguments.description: Free-form task description used to call membrane_context for a single-repo context packet.

content.text: Recap the current session for ${taskId} in session ${sessionId}. First call membrane_working_context with operation=load, sessionId=${sessionId}, taskId=${taskId} and the same caller/repository you would use for ${task}. Then call membrane_context with task="${task}" against repository=${repository}. Summarize: (1) the active working contexts, (2) the federated context packet blocks, (3) any typed omissions. Do not propose durable knowledge and do not submit feedback — recap is read-only.
